newsitem.title: USA: PageNet shares trade heavily on launch news.
newsitem.headline: PageNet shares trade heavily on launch news.

text.p: Paging Network Inc shares were trading heavily Thursday, and near the stock's year low, because investors are frustrated that the latest launch of VoiceNow service in northern California does not include San Francisco, an analyst said.

Christopher Larsen, an analyst at NatWest Securities, said PageNet's Wednesday announcement that it was launching VoiceNow in parts of California and Nevada revealed that, contrary to expectations, it was not ready to launch in San Francisco due to regulatory delays.
Shares were rebounding on Thursday afternoon, up from its year low of 8-1/8 hit during trading on Wednesday.
The fifth most active issue on Nasdaq, PageNet shares were up 11/32 at 8-23/32 on volume of about 5.6 million shares.
Larsen said investors were also concerned about ongoing pricing plan tests for VoiceNow, an advanced voice messaging product, although Larsen said he did not share that concern.
"People need to calm down and hear some good solid actual news before they really start getting back into the stock," he said.
